        iframe.addEventListener('error', () => {

        // Ensure the iframe has loaded before injecting the style

          // Create a <style> element with the desired CSS rule

          style.textContent = `

          // Append the style element to the iframe's head
          iframe.contentDocument.head.appendChild(style);
          iframe.contentDocument.documentElement.style.fontSize = BASE_FONT_SIZE;
        });
      });

      window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
        if (event.data.type === 'feedHeight') {
          if (!anchorRef.classList.contains('open')) {
            anchorRef.classList.add('open');
            iframe.style.opacity = "1";
          }
          if (event.data.containerHeightPx) {

<script type="module">
    (function () {
        // Register modules for UMD build
        Swiper.use([Swiper.Navigation, Swiper.FreeMode, Swiper.Keyboard, Swiper.A11y]);

        // Build pills from main slide titles
        const mainEl = document.getElementById("heroMain");
        const pillsWrap = document.querySelector("#heroPills .swiper-wrapper");
        const slides = Array.from(mainEl.querySelectorAll(".swiper-slide"));

        slides.forEach((slide, idx) => {
            const title = (slide.getAttribute("data-title") || `Slide ${idx + 1}`).trim();
            const pillSlide = document.createElement("div");
            pillSlide.className = "swiper-slide";
            pillSlide.innerHTML = `<button class="pill" type="button" data-index="${idx}" aria-controls="heroMain" aria-label="Go to ${title}">${title}</button>`;
            pillsWrap.appendChild(pillSlide);
        });

        // Init the pills swiper
        const pillsSwiper = new Swiper("#heroPills", {
            slidesPerView: "auto",
            spaceBetween: 0,
            freeMode: true,
            keyboard: { enabled: true },
            a11y: { enabled: true },
        });

        // Handle the fade on the pills
        const pillsContainer = document.getElementById("heroPills");
        function updatePillFades() {
            // When at the very start, no left fade; when at the end, no right fade.
            pillsContainer.classList.toggle("has-left-fade", !pillsSwiper.isBeginning);
            pillsContainer.classList.toggle("has-right-fade", !pillsSwiper.isEnd);
        }

        // Run on init and whenever position could change
        pillsSwiper.on("init", updatePillFades);
        pillsSwiper.on("setTranslate", updatePillFades);
        pillsSwiper.on("resize", updatePillFades);
        pillsSwiper.on("slidesLengthChange", updatePillFades);

        // If you already called new Swiper(...), trigger an initial update:
        updatePillFades();

        // Init the main swiper
        const mainSwiper = new Swiper("#heroMain", {
            slidesPerView: 1,
            speed: 600,
            loop: true,
            navigation: {
                nextEl: ".button-next",
                prevEl: ".button-prev",
            },
            keyboard: { enabled: true },
            a11y: { enabled: true },
            on: {
                init() {
                    setActivePill(this.realIndex);
                    ensurePillVisible(this.realIndex);
                },
                slideChange() {
                    setActivePill(this.realIndex);
                    ensurePillVisible(this.realIndex);
                },
            },
            autoplay: {
                delay: 5000,
            },
        });

        // Delegate clicks on pills -> go to that slide
        document.getElementById("heroPills").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
            const btn = e.target.closest(".pill");
            if (!btn) return;
            const i = Number(btn.dataset.index);
            if (Number.isNaN(i)) return;

            if (mainSwiper.params.loop) mainSwiper.slideToLoop(i);
            else mainSwiper.slideTo(i);
        });

        // Helpers
        function setActivePill(i) {
            const pills = document.querySelectorAll("#heroPills .pill");

            let prevActive = null;
            pills.forEach((b, idx) => {
                if (b.classList.contains("is-active") && idx !== i) prevActive = b;
            });

            // Instantly reset the previously active pill (no reverse animation)
            if (prevActive) {
                prevActive.classList.add("no-anim"); // kill transitions/animations
                prevActive.classList.remove("is-active"); // background-size jumps to 0, color snaps back
                void prevActive.offsetWidth; // force reflow so .no-anim takes effect
                requestAnimationFrame(() => prevActive.classList.remove("no-anim")); // allow future anims
            }

            // Activate the new one (this will animate 0% -> 100% over 3s)
            pills.forEach((b, idx) => {
                const active = idx === i;
                b.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
                b.setAttribute("aria-current", active ? "true" : "false");
            });
        }

        function ensurePillVisible(i) {
            // Bring the i-th pill into view in the pills swiper.
            const target = Math.max(0, Math.min(i, pillsSwiper.slides.length - 1));
            pillsSwiper.slideTo(target, 300);
        }
    })();
</script>

<script type="x-shader/x-vertex" id="vertexshader">
  attribute float scale;
  void main() {
    vec4 mvPosition = modelViewMatrix * vec4( position, 1.0 );
    gl_PointSize = scale * ( 300.0 / - mvPosition.z );
    gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mvPosition;
  }
</script>

<script type="x-shader/x-fragment" id="fragmentshader">
  uniform vec3 color;
  uniform vec3 fogColor;
  uniform float fogNear;
  uniform float fogFar;
  void main() {
    if ( length( gl_PointCoord - vec2( 0.5, 0.5 ) ) > 0.475 ) discard;
    gl_FragColor = vec4( color, 1.0 );
    #ifdef USE_FOG
      #ifdef USE_LOGDEPTHBUF_EXT
        float depth = gl_FragDepthEXT / gl_FragCoord.w;
      #else
        float depth = gl_FragCoord.z / gl_FragCoord.w;
      #endif
      float fogFactor = smoothstep( fogNear, fogFar, depth );
      gl_FragColor.rgb = mix( gl_FragColor.rgb, fogColor, fogFactor );
    #endif
  }
</script>

<script id="rendered-js">
  function getRandomInt(min, max) {
    min = Math.ceil(min);
    max = Math.floor(max);
    return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min) + min); //The maximum is exclusive and the minimum is inclusive
  }

  const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;

  const SEPARATION = 60,
        AMOUNTX = 250,
        AMOUNTY = 150;

  let container;
  let camera, scene, renderer;

  let particles,
      count = 0;

  let mouseX = 0,
      mouseY = 0;

  let windowHalfX = window.innerWidth / 2;
  let windowHalfY = window.innerHeight / 2;

  //init();
  //animate();

  function init() {
    container = document.createElement("div");
    document.body.appendChild(container);

    camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      70,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      1,
      10000
    );
    camera.position.y = 600;
    camera.position.z = 700;
    //camera.rotation.x = -35 * Math.PI / 180;
    camera.rotation.x = -25 * Math.PI / 180;
    //camera.rotation.z = -20 * Math.PI / 180;

    scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color( 0x1a1a1a );
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog( 0x1a1a1a, 100, 6000 );

    //

    const numParticles = AMOUNTX * AMOUNTY;

    const positions = new Float32Array(numParticles * 3);
    const scales = new Float32Array(numParticles);

    let i = 0,
        j = 0;

    for (let ix = 0; ix < AMOUNTX; ix++) {
      for (let iy = 0; iy < AMOUNTY; iy++) {
        positions[i] = ix * SEPARATION - (AMOUNTX * SEPARATION) / 2; // x
        positions[i + 1] = 0; // y
        positions[i + 2] = iy * SEPARATION - (AMOUNTY * SEPARATION) / 2; // z

        scales[j] = 1;

        i += 3;
        j++;
      }
    }

    const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    geometry.setAttribute("position", new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
    geometry.setAttribute("scale", new THREE.BufferAttribute(scales, 1));

    var uniforms = {
      color: { value: new THREE.Color(0x393B40) },
      fogColor:    { type: "c", value: scene.fog.color },
      fogNear:     { type: "f", value: scene.fog.near },
      fogFar:      { type: "f", value: scene.fog.far }
    };
    var vertexShader = document.getElementById('vertexshader').textContent;
    var fragmentShader = document.getElementById('fragmentshader').textContent;
    var material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial(
      {
        uniforms : uniforms,
        vertexShader : vertexShader,
        fragmentShader : fragmentShader,
        fog: true
      }
    );

    //

    particles = new THREE.Points(geometry, material);
    scene.add(particles);

    //

    renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
    renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    const heroCanvas = document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
    heroCanvas.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    //container.style.touchAction = "none";
    //container.addEventListener("pointermove", onPointerMove);

    //

    window.addEventListener("resize", onWindowResize);
  }

  function onWindowResize() {
    windowHalfX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    windowHalfY = window.innerHeight / 2;

    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
  }

  //

  function onPointerMove(event) {
    if (event.isPrimary === false) return;

    mouseX = event.clientX - windowHalfX;
    mouseY = event.clientY - windowHalfY;
  }

  //

  function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);

    render();
    //stats.update();
  }

  function render() {
    //camera.position.x += (mouseX - camera.position.x) * 0.05;
    //camera.position.y += (-mouseY - camera.position.y) * 0.05;
    //camera.lookAt(scene.position);

    const positions = particles.geometry.attributes.position.array;
    const scales = particles.geometry.attributes.scale.array;

    let i = 0,
        j = 0;

    for (let ix = 0; ix < AMOUNTX; ix++) {
      for (let iy = 0; iy < AMOUNTY; iy++) {
        positions[i + 1] =
          Math.pow(math.sin((ix + count) * 0.3), 1) * 50 + Math.sin((iy + count) * 0.25) * 50;

        scales[j] =
          (Math.sin((ix + count) * 0.3) + 1) * 20 +
          (Math.sin((iy + count) * 0.5) + 1) * 20;

        i += 3;
        j++;
      }
    }

    particles.geometry.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
    particles.geometry.attributes.scale.needsUpdate = true;

    renderer.render(scene, camera);

    count += 0.01;
  }
</script>
